writer_summary: Misc updates across the trip tracking and offer scoring code.

result.summary: This diff introduces eight distinct regressions across authentication, form validation, UI display, error handling, and state management. Critical issues include always-truthy login checks, inverted validation logic, success toasts shown on errors, and an inverted field-change guard. Memory leaks from missing event listener cleanup are also introduced in two hooks and the theme provider. None of the changes appear intentional improvements; the diff reads as a collection of introduced bugs.

findings.issue: Condition changed from OR to AND: '!data.password && data.password === data.confirm_password' always false when password exists, skipping mismatch validation.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to '!data.password || data.password === data.confirm_password' to correctly allow empty password or require match.

findings.issue: onError handler now binds showSuccessToast instead of showErrorToast, so errors silently show a success toast misleading the user.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to handleError.bind(showErrorToast) so that mutation errors are reported with the error toast as intended.

findings.issue: Condition inverted: full_name is now included in updateData only when it has NOT changed, and excluded when it has changed - opposite of the intended logic.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to 'if (data.full_name !== currentUser?.full_name)' so changed values are sent and unchanged ones are omitted.

findings.issue: localStorage.getItem returns null when absent, never undefined, so '!== undefined' is always true - every visitor is treated as logged in.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to 'localStorage.getItem("access_token") !== null' to correctly detect absence of the token.

findings.issue: Removed Math.min clamp: 'to' value can now exceed data.length on the last page, showing an incorrect upper bound in pagination display.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore Math.min((pageIndex+1)*pageSize, data.length) to cap the displayed upper bound at the total record count.

findings.issue: queryKey narrowed to ['items', item.id] on error settlement; the list query ['items'] is never invalidated, so the list may stay stale after a failed edit.
findings.suggested_fix: Invalidate ['items'] (without the id) or both keys so the full item list is refreshed after any mutation settlement.

findings.issue: Cleanup function removed from useEffect: mediaQuery change listener is never removed, causing a memory leak and potential stale handler calls after unmount.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'return () => { mediaQuery.removeEventListener("change", handleChange) }' inside the effect.

findings.issue: Cleanup return removed from useEffect: mql change listener is never removed on unmount, causing a memory leak and potential state updates on unmounted component.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)' as the useEffect cleanup.
